question: After the ledger prerequisites land, does the rebased exact-head hosted evidence demonstrate complete, credential-safe repair receipt publication without changing primary repair outcomes?
rationale: The remaining uncertainty is cross-job GitHub Actions integration and durable artifact behavior, which source inspection and unit tests cannot conclusively resolve.

options.title: Require final hosted evidence
options.body: Inspect one successful and one intentionally failed repair run plus their durable ledger artifacts on the final rebased head before merge.

options.title: Accept source and checks
options.body: Merge after the stack is rebased and required checks pass without requiring a hosted failed-run artifact.

recommendation.title: Require final hosted evidence
recommendation.body: Inspect one successful and one intentionally failed repair run plus their durable ledger artifacts on the final rebased head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current-main repair surfaces and authored the complete ledger stack, giving them the strongest context for the final artifact review.
